description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Rectification of Gazette No. 2054/45 dated 18.01.2018, that Published Re-Amendment to the City of Colombo Development Plan 2008
categorisation: This gazette content is a correction notice for a previously published gazette notification regarding amendments to the City of Colombo Development Plan. It specifically addresses errors in the printed version of regulatory documents related to urban development planning. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it concerns the correction of statutory instruments and regulatory documentation prepared under the Urban Development Authority Law.
